name: Ink
source:
You were born in a race of the Ink, a feared group of people whose writing are cursed to comes to life. Suppressed from learning any sort of education, the only way for an Ink to learn literacy is to pass The Brush exam, an elite exam previously only available to the upper class that proves an Ink’s ability to control their curse. However, two years ago the government finally opened the Brush Exam to the general public and in 5 days, as part of the first generation of low-class Ink’s to attend the academy, you will be taking The Brush Exam and prove you are worthy to become a brush.

Only problem is, you still can’t control your curse.

[From [url=https://alomont.itch.io/ink]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你出生在墨水族中，这是一群令人畏惧的人，他们的文字被诅咒而变得栩栩如生。由于无法接受任何形式的教育，墨族学习识字的唯一方法就是通过笔试，这是一项以前只有上层阶级才能参加的精英考试，证明墨族有能力控制自己的诅咒。然而，两年前，政府终于向公众开放了笔试，五天后，作为第一代进入书院的下层墨子，你们将参加笔试，证明自己值得成为一名笔试。

唯一的问题是，你仍然无法控制你的诅咒。

[来自[url=https://alomont.itch.io/ink]Itch.io[/url]]
